Latin word

circum

circum (+ accusative)

preposition with the accusative; also an adverb

around, round (all round)

In this lexicon

  • around

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. Heaut. 290–291: capillus passus, prōlixus, circum caput rejectus neglegenter; Verg. G. 2.523: dulcēs pendent circum ōscula nātī

Examples

  • capillus passus, prōlixus, circum caput rejectus neglegenter

    her hair loose, long, thrown carelessly round her headTer. Heaut. 290–291
